**Exploring invisible characters**

I’m considering characters similar to Harry Potter’s invisibility cloak or possibly something like “The Man with No Name.” There might be a connection to “Nobody” from John Wick 4, where the main character may have qualities of invisibility or anonymity. I think this also relates to the concept of zero or nobody. “No Time to Die” could come into play too. The repeated “E11” might further emphasize the uniqueness of zero. It's time I share my guesses!
